source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 rows 74 (Business man, Quaternius 24-clip Animated Characters) and 67 (Man in suit, Quaternius Animated Man/Woman) both point at poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. One model covers both: Suit_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt, the same CC0 pack, rig, scale and clips as man-casual (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit and six more; no run, jump or death clip). Height 1.75 m like man-casual: the chibi proportions (big head) are the artist's, the overall size is a grown man's. The pack also has a Suit_Female (not shipped here).
